EDWARD HOPPER / 1914 / DESKTOP COLOR STUDIES

Five ways to
spend the blue hour.

One painting. Five deliberately different directions. Explore the actual typefaces, terminal colors, and desktop surfaces together. All five stay dark; the first starts with your #051626.

Preview only — your current desktop stays as it is. Download any palette as an Omarchy colors.toml; font names are listed separately for applying after you choose. Display faces suit headings and reading; the monospace face is the proposed terminal and bar font. Nerd Font variants may be needed for desktop icons.
Fonts are embedded for offline viewing, sourced from Google Fonts. Painting: Edward Hopper, Soir Bleu — Whitney Museum. Click any swatch to copy its hex value.
